name: second-opinion
description: Codex, Cursor and a second Claude inside Claude Code: an agent room (one chat, @mentions, handoffs) plus one-shot reviews and delegation

roomSeed.title: Room: context from the main Claude session
roomSeed.description: What the room's agents (Codex, Cursor and the room's own Claude) learn about the main Claude conversation the room was opened from, when their session starts: none, the last turns, a summary the main Claude writes, or the full conversation (capped at 60,000 characters).

roomSeedTurns.title: Room: turns to share when seeding 'recent'
roomSeedTurns.description: How many of the latest Claude-session turns a fresh room agent gets.

claudeReturn.title: Room: context sent back to the main session
claudeReturn.description: What reaches the main Claude session when the room @mentions @main or you press Send room to main: just that message, the latest room messages, a summary of the room, or the whole room (capped at 30,000 characters).

claudeReturnMessages.title: Room: messages to send back for 'recent'
claudeReturnMessages.description: How many of the latest room messages go with a message to Claude.
